resources.string: 1. Connect phone and TV to the same network. Scan this code.\n2. Choose “Push update APK” and upload a newer Halo TV Lite APK.\n3. Return here, select Check for updates, then Install uploaded update.
Checks the Halo website and GitHub. Only verified Halo TV Lite APKs can be installed.
This test version is up to date. No newer Lite release was found.
Cannot reach the update server or complete the download. Try again, or use the QR code for a manual update.
The package has been verified. If installation did not open, select Install uploaded update.
Not enough storage space. Free some space and try again.
The package could not pass version, device or signature verification. It has not been installed.
